facts_transferred.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL
facts_transferred.fact: Figure 2-17 maps the WTC 1 Case B severed or heavily damaged core-column segments between Floors 91 and 97.

facts_transferred.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL_LIMITE
facts_transferred.fact: The isolated WTC 1 core model extended from Floor 89 to Floor 106 and included columns, core beams and slabs. Case B structural-damage runs did not converge even with lateral restraints. The isolated model did not capture transfer between core and exterior walls through floors or the hat truss.

facts_transferred.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL
facts_transferred.fact: The global model used equivalent vertical springs at its truncated base. Individually modeled core beams were those with moment connections; non-moment beam axial stiffness was combined with the in-plane slab stiffness. NIST states that the composite floor representation could redistribute load locally among neighboring columns.

facts_transferred.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL
facts_transferred.fact: After impact, loads from severed columns were redistributed mostly to neighboring columns. At Floor 98 the core carried about one percent more gravity load; Column 705 buckled and Columns 605 and 804 showed minor buckling.

model_assumptions.columns: Elastic axial EA/L springs capped by the V8B room-temperature nominal compressive capacity for each historic WF proxy. Case B severed/heavy segments are removed before loading.
model_assumptions.beams: V8H bilinear vertical-transfer law: k=12EI/L^3, Vy=connection_factor*2Mp/L, one floor plane, 1 percent post-yield tangent, fracture at 0.02 rad relative rotation.
model_assumptions.column_failure: A column spring is removed if compressive force exceeds its V8B nominal room-temperature capacity.
omitted: explicit shell slab bending and cracking
published adjusted slab modulus because its numeric value is unavailable
column and joint rotational degrees of freedom

gate_definition.required_condition: The Case B cold load must reach the Floor 93 support without a disconnected loaded component or capacity-triggered cascade in at least one physically sourced topology; a reconstructed upper envelope alone cannot validate the as-built path.
gate_definition.thermal_authorization_rule: Thermal continuation remains blocked if only the reconstructed orthogonal envelope passes or if every core-only case fails.

summary.gate_label: GATE FROID NON VALIDE : noyau multi-etages insuffisant
summary.gate_explanation: Comme le noyau isole Case B de NIST, toutes les enveloppes perdent l'equilibre.
summary.report_conclusion: Les deux topologies multi-etages perdent l'equilibre avant la demande froide complete. Ce resultat est qualitativement coherent avec la non-convergence du noyau isole Case B de NIST et indique que le prochain chemin a introduire est le couplage vers les facades et le hat truss, pas une resistance locale arbitrairement augmentee.
summary.gate_decision: **NON VALIDE.** Le noyau reduit multi-etages ne suffit pas. La prochaine iteration doit ajouter les planchers de bureau, facades et/ou le hat truss froid avant toute thermique ou Blender dynamique.
